column1: # flags.tsv — the feature-flag registry (owner and removal name the tickets).
# Tab-separated: name default kind owner removal expires description
#   default  on | off     kind  feature | content
#   owner    the ticket that adds the flag   removal  the sub-task that deletes it
#   expires  YYYY-MM-DD; scripts/ci/check-flags.sh fails CI once it has passed (14 days from birth)
# A flag is read only through scripts/lib/flags.sh, flags.py or flags.mjs, and never under
# scripts/hooks/, in a gate script or on a ci-trust-paths.txt path (docs/internals/config-layers.md).
